method: Seeded layered SVG from hand-drawn periodic profiles, rasterized at native @2; capped source:raster on cave pages

source.encoding: every PNG re-encoded by scripts/png-canonical.mjs (pako 2.1.0: RGBA8, filter 0, deflate level 9, no ancillary chunks)

reference.use: Manually drawn angular vault and low ridge silhouettes at matched tile scale; no reference pixels in generated art

notes: Two native @2 layers; flat cool tiers, no outlines, horizontal period512 logical px. Vertical repeat mirrors alternate192px strips for a384px (8tile) period and continuous flat edge collars. T4 owns known-air clipping, parallax, reveal and recessed dug walls. Broad vaults are the provisional default; needles and shelves remain selectable.
